scripts.generate: npm run generate:go && npm run generate:ts
scripts.generate:go: mkdir -p pkg/contractsv1 && go run github.com/atombender/go-jsonschema@v0.24.1 --package contractsv1 --struct-name-from-title --only-models --tags json --output pkg/contractsv1/zz_generated.go contracts/codegen.v1.schema.json
scripts.generate:ts: mkdir -p web/src/generated && quicktype --lang typescript --just-types --no-date-times --src contracts/codegen.v1.schema.json --src-lang schema --out web/src/generated/agent-workflow.v1.ts
